The '''Republic Diplomatic Corps''' was a division in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] government that helped deal with other [[Star system/Legends|systems]], in and outside the Republic's borders.

==Organization==
The RDC was a branch of the Republic government that helped it to function alongside the many varying traditional government of [[Star system/Legends|systems]] in and outside the Republic's borders. They worked to help [[Senator/Legends|senators]] and [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassadors]] of the Republic function with other senators and ambassadors.

Republic Diplomatic Corps consisted of various species that worked in several different roles. [[Jedi Consular]]s were also known to work closely with them.

==History==
This organization existed as far back as the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] where [[Minister]] [[Plennid]] was a member and was tasked with aiding in the efforts at securing an alliance with [[Bareesh Fenn'ak Torill|Bareesh]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. However, the bodyguards assigned to the minister were killed and the diplomatic efforts faced opposition from the [[Kintan Kings]] criminal gang.

[[Davim Cross]] also worked for the Republic Diplomatic Corps.
